prefix_sensitive_full_decode.operation: For each candidate token, decode the complete proposed token prefix, rebuild or increment the frozen character controller from the exact decoded text, and admit only a live exact prefix.
prefix_sensitive_full_decode.reason: No standalone token-piece or context-free suffix assumption is accepted without tokenizer-specific proof.

context_free_piece_trie.permission_condition: The compatibility audit proves exact allowed-token-set equality with the prefix-sensitive oracle for every declared state and decoding class in both audit lanes.
context_free_piece_trie.fallback: Any mismatch or unclassified context sensitivity selects the prefix-sensitive full-decode strategy fail-closed.

mixed_class_strategy.permission_condition: Every context-free class has a deterministic classifier and equality proof; all remaining classes use the oracle.
mixed_class_strategy.receipt_requirement: Record the strategy class used for every token-admission computation.

common: bounded required JSON strings, escapes, Unicode, and closing transitions
authority_reconciliation: request-bound source roles and SHA-256 literals
variable sequential finding links and exact finding graph

token_admission_contract.rule: A token is admitted only if its entire contextual decoded effect is accepted by the frozen request-bound character controller and ends at a live or terminal state.
token_admission_contract.empty_decoding: Excluded by default because it does not advance liveness.
token_admission_contract.special_tokens: Exclude every non-EOS special/control token unless a later separately approved contract proves a harmless exact decoding.
token_admission_contract.eos: Admit EOS only for a terminal character state; reject it at every live nonterminal state.
token_admission_contract.invalid_unicode_or_cleanup: Reject or route through the full-decode oracle; never repair decoded text.
token_admission_contract.semantic_boundary: Projection establishes only membership in the frozen syntactic response language. Pydantic parsing, source projection, controller receipts, and semantic adjudication remain independent fail-closed layers.

cache_identity_requirements: tokenizer canonical identity and tokenizer file hashes
decoder, normalization, cleanup, and special-token configuration identity
audit lane and frozen grammar identity
request context identity including ordered entries and authority source binding
exact character state including reference and finding substates
complete decoded-prefix or token-prefix identity for prefix-sensitive classes
